assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
At least one anomalies block is present

Every anomaly type used is one of the six Orchestra supports: pipeline_duration_above_baseline, pipeline_duration_below_baseline, task_duration_above_baseline, task_duration_below_baseline, operation_duration_above_baseline, operation_duration_below_baseline
Every below-baseline anomaly block sets an explicit type: field (an omitted type defaults to above-baseline, not below)
percentage_above_baseline values (where set) stay within 1-1000, and percentage_below_baseline values (where set) stay within 1-99
A pipeline_duration_* anomaly sits at the pipeline's top level, not nested under a task
A task_duration_* or operation_duration_* anomaly is nested under the specific task it monitors, not left at the pipeline level
operation_duration_* blocks are only used on DBT or DBT_CORE tasks
Does not invent an anomaly monitor the user did not ask for and nothing about the pipeline motivates
